'02' type, tpd.CCY, tpd.FINPROD_ID, tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, tpd.CHL_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fprod_type.TYPE_6 assetType, nvl(tpda.PAY_TYPE,wtpda.PAY_TYPE) bonusMode, (case when nvl(tpda.PAY_TYPE,wtpda.PAY_TYPE) = #{BONUS_MODE_02} then nvl(tpda.BONUS_CFM_DATE,wtpda.BONUS_CFM_DATE) else null end) reInvesDate, tpd.INT_AMT tradeAmt, null qty, nvl(tpda.REG_DATE,wtpda.REG_DATE) registDate, tpd.TRADE_DATE exRightsDate, (case when nvl(tpda.PAY_TYPE,wtpda.PAY_TYPE) = #{BONUS_MODE_01} then nvl(tpda.BONUS_CFM_DATE,wtpda.BONUS_CFM_DATE) else null end) arriveDate,
null registShare, tpd.UNIT_CPRICE, tpd.B_TRADE_ID, tpd.P_TRADE_ID, tpd.PS, tpd.REMARK,

'03' type, tpd.CCY, tpd.FINPROD_ID, tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, tpd.CHL_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fprod_type.TYPE_6 assetType, nvl(tpda.PAY_TYPE,wtpda.PAY_TYPE) bonusMode, null reInvesDate, tpd.TRADE_AMT, null qty, nvl(tpda.REG_DATE,wtpda.REG_DATE) registDate, btrd.TRADE_DATE exRightsDate, tpd.TRADE_DATE arriveDate,
null registShare, tpd.UNIT_CPRICE, tpd.B_TRADE_ID, tpd.P_TRADE_ID, tpd.PS, tpd.REMARK,

'04' type, tpd.CCY, tpd.FINPROD_ID, tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, tpd.CHL_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, fprod_type.TYPE_6 assetType, nvl(tpda.PAY_TYPE,wtpda.PAY_TYPE) bonusMode, tpd.TRADE_DATE reInvesDate, tpd.INT_AMT tradeAmt, tpd.SHARE_AMT qty, nvl(tpda.REG_DATE,wtpda.REG_DATE) registDate, btrd.TRADE_DATE exRightsDate, null arriveDate,
null registShare, tpd.UNIT_CPRICE, tpd.B_TRADE_ID, tpd.P_TRADE_ID, tpd.PS, tpd.REMARK,

left join PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpda on tpda.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
left join WFL_PA_TRD_FIN_DEAL_TOTAL wtpda on wtpda.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID and fp.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_JZ}
left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID
left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL btrd on btrd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.B_TRADE_ID
